Spot supplies three-block holding and self-healing on the lower route. The swap also changes who shares Ansel-centered shell splash.

I’ll retain R104’s costs, deployment times, physicians, Steward placement, and 4280 retreat. Upper Midnight’s long-term survival and later roadblock clearance remain unproved and must be checked in the complete run.

Keep Friston alive through changed shell-sharing/heal allocation, then Friston blocks officers #11/#13 on route11/14 while Fang and forward Midnight kill them. A first block alone is insufficient; require actual enemy deaths and no leaks. No unrecorded replacement is assumed.

Midnight's upper side reach attacks eastern roadblock3, freeing protected3 to travel to western1 before repeated artillery exposure. Killing early officers is not credited as protected3 repair. Upper Midnight has no ordinary physician range coverage.
